name: Tone and Policy Compliance
summary: Verify that the document draft uses an appropriate tone and addresses all required policy checklist items
purpose: Verify that the document draft uses an appropriate tone and addresses all required policy checklist items. Documents must match the specified tone requirement and demonstrate compliance with organizational policy items.

audit_checks.label: Document tone does not match required tone
Some but not all policy checklist items are addressed
Less than half of policy checklist items are addressed
final_output is PASS but tone is not compliant
final_output is PASS but not all policy items are addressed

deterministic_checks.description: detected_tone must match one of the enum values
required_tone must match one of the enum values
tone_compliant must be true when detected_tone equals required_tone
PASS requires tone compliance and all policy items addressed
deterministic_checks.condition: final_output == "PASS" implies tone_compliant == true AND policy_compliance_ratio == 1.0

math_checks.description: Calculate policy compliance ratio as addressed items divided by total items

evidence_checks.description: The detected_tone classification must be supported by quoted evidence from the document
Each policy_checklist item marked addressed=true must have a non-empty evidence field citing document location

flag_rules.message: Document tone does not match required tone
Some but not all policy checklist items are addressed
Less than half of policy checklist items are addressed
final_output is PASS but tone is not compliant
final_output is PASS but not all policy items are addressed
